# Agency User stories

**Agency User:** Staff of one Agency who staff Shifts and submit hours.

<a id="req-agency-web-0001"></a>

### Agency menu and Home page

`REQ-AGENCY-WEB-0001` · first slice

- **Who:** Agency User
- **What:** The Agency menu lists an Agency User's screens, and Home is the page they land on.
- **Why:** Each persona gets its own view *(PLT-1: RBAC: unit (buyer), agency (supplier), corporate/program owner)*
- **Sources:** [PRD](https://instawork.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/ec/pages/4841898227/Compass+VMS+Product+Requirements) Pages; [PRD](https://instawork.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/ec/pages/4841898227/Compass+VMS+Product+Requirements) §1 Dashboard / Profile; [Compass sheet](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1SlUyWtbhik3KEKW4VAskSAEfS8v3S-_OjgVfZpA2WM4/edit) PLT-1

**Acceptance criteria**

- **R1.** The Agency User menu lists Home, Shifts, Workers, Timesheets, Rate Card, Uploads, and Users, in that order.
- **R12.** Home is the page an Agency User lands on, first in the menu; it holds only the sections other requirements add, and says there is nothing to do when none has anything to show.

**Open questions it rests on**

- [D-107](open-questions.md#d-107) How can the first slice be used before every screen and feature exists?
- [D-123](open-questions.md#d-123) Which screens does an Agency User have?

<a id="req-agency-web-0002"></a>

### List the Releases sent to the Agency and answer them

`REQ-AGENCY-WEB-0002` · first slice

- **Who:** Agency User
- **What:** On the Shifts screen an Agency User sees every Release sent to their Agency, with its Shift, Bill Rates, and site instructions. They accept or decline each Release, or several at once.
- **Why:**
  - VMS requirement: onboarding instructions (attire, directions, parking) *(SC-6: Structured shift instructions shared with the agency and sent to workers by text or email: parking, entrance, directions, site contact, attire)*
  - Agencies are half the users; they need to know the moment a shift is theirs *(SC-8: Agency notifications for released shifts (email or SMS), with accept or decline)*
- **Sources:** [Compass sheet](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1SlUyWtbhik3KEKW4VAskSAEfS8v3S-_OjgVfZpA2WM4/edit) SC-8; [Compass sheet](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1SlUyWtbhik3KEKW4VAskSAEfS8v3S-_OjgVfZpA2WM4/edit) SC-6; [PRD](https://instawork.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/ec/pages/4841898227/Compass+VMS+Product+Requirements) §2 Shifts

**Acceptance criteria**

- **R1.** The Shifts screen lists each Release sent to the Agency with its Unit, Position, work date, start and end times, headcount, ASSIGNED count, and status, grouped by work date.
- **R2.** It opens on PENDING and ACCEPTED Releases whose Shifts have not ended, soonest first, and a second tab lists every other Release, newest first.
- **R3.** Both tabs filter by status, Unit, Position, and date range.
- **R4.** Opening a Release shows the Unit's name and address, the Shift's Position, times, and planned break, and the Release's headcount and regular, overtime, and double-time Bill Rates.
- **R5.** While the Release is PENDING or ACCEPTED, the page also shows the Shift's parking, entrance, directions, site contact, and attire, as [`REQ-ORDERING-0006`](business-rules.md#req-ordering-0006) allows.
- **R6.** Each Release shows its own headcount beside the Shift's whole headcount, whether any other Agency holds the Shift, and the total headcount other Agencies hold, as [`REQ-DISPATCH-0002.R9`](business-rules.md#req-dispatch-0002) gives them, never their names.
- **R7.** A PENDING Release offers Accept, which calls [`REQ-DISPATCH-0002`](business-rules.md#req-dispatch-0002) for its whole headcount, and the Release then shows as ACCEPTED and can be staffed.
- **R8.** A PENDING Release offers Decline, and an ACCEPTED one does until its Shift starts; Decline takes a reason and calls [`REQ-DISPATCH-0002`](business-rules.md#req-dispatch-0002).
- **R9.** Before an ACCEPTED Release is declined, the page says how many ASSIGNED Workers will come off the Shift and asks the Agency User to confirm.
- **R10.** The Agency User can select several PENDING Releases, such as those of one chained block, and accept or decline them in one step; each is answered on its own, and any refused are listed.
- **R11.** A DECLINED, WITHDRAWN, CANCELLED, or EXPIRED Release stays in the list under its status, with its decline reason when it has one, and offers no action.
- **R14.** The CSV download of the Releases list, through [`REQ-SHELL-0010`](every-user.md#req-shell-0010), carries each Shift's id in a shift_id column.
- **R15.** This requirement registers the Release page of R4 with [`REQ-SHELL-0007`](every-user.md#req-shell-0007) for subject Release and role AGENCY_USER.

**Business rules it saves through**

- [`REQ-DISPATCH-0001` Send a Shift's headcount to a chosen Agency](business-rules.md#req-dispatch-0001)
- [`REQ-DISPATCH-0002` Accept or decline a Release](business-rules.md#req-dispatch-0002)
- [`REQ-ORDERING-0006` Share structured site instructions with the Agency and Workers](business-rules.md#req-ordering-0006)
- [`REQ-WORKFORCE-0003` Assign named Workers to an accepted Release](business-rules.md#req-workforce-0003)
- [`REQ-ORG-0009` Allow each action only to its role and scope](business-rules.md#req-org-0009)
- [`REQ-WORKFORCE-0016` Take Workers off Shifts automatically and recheck their eligibility](business-rules.md#req-workforce-0016)

**Open questions it rests on**

- [D-87](open-questions.md#d-87) What does an Agency see about other Agencies holding the same Shift? The sessions report that Agencies cannot tell today whether they are the only one, and the PRD's shared Shift detail names every Supplier.
- [D-107](open-questions.md#d-107) How can the first slice be used before every screen and feature exists?
- [D-108](open-questions.md#d-108) Which rows does a list show first, where no source gives an order?
- [D-159](open-questions.md#d-159) Can an Agency accept part of a Release?
- [D-160](open-questions.md#d-160) Can an Agency give back a Release it has accepted?
- [D-161](open-questions.md#d-161) What ends a Release that no Agency has answered?
- [D-166](open-questions.md#d-166) Must an Agency accept a chained block as a whole and keep the same Workers on every Shift?
- [D-252](open-questions.md#d-252) Which record is each notification about?

<a id="req-agency-web-0003"></a>

### Keep the Agency's Worker roster

`REQ-AGENCY-WEB-0003` · first slice

- **Who:** Agency User
- **What:** On the Workers screen an Agency User lists the Agency's Workers, adds them one at a time, changes their details, and deactivates them.
- **Why:** Compass needs to know who is actually coming on site *(WA-1: Agency roster: agencies assign named workers to allocated shifts)*
- **Sources:** [Compass sheet](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1SlUyWtbhik3KEKW4VAskSAEfS8v3S-_OjgVfZpA2WM4/edit) WA-1; [PRD](https://instawork.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/ec/pages/4841898227/Compass+VMS+Product+Requirements) §4 Professionals

**Acceptance criteria**

- **R1.** The Workers screen lists the Agency's Workers by last name with name, email, phone, city, Positions, and whether active.
- **R3.** The roster filters to active or inactive Workers and by Position, and searches by name, email, or phone.
- **R4.** Add Worker takes a first and last name and, optionally, an email, phone, city, Positions from the catalog, and a photo, and saves through [`REQ-WORKFORCE-0001`](business-rules.md#req-workforce-0001).
- **R5.** Each Worker offers Edit for the same fields, and Deactivate or Reactivate; an inactive Worker is marked as one who cannot be assigned.
- **R9.** Deactivate first warns that the Worker comes off Shifts that have not started, as [`REQ-WORKFORCE-0001.R11`](business-rules.md#req-workforce-0001) says.

**Business rules it saves through**

- [`REQ-WORKFORCE-0001` Hold each Agency's Worker roster](business-rules.md#req-workforce-0001)
- [`REQ-CATALOG-0001` Hold the Compass Position catalog](business-rules.md#req-catalog-0001)
- [`REQ-ORG-0009` Allow each action only to its role and scope](business-rules.md#req-org-0009)

**Open questions it rests on**

- [D-50](open-questions.md#d-50) What must an Agency give to add a Worker?
- [D-89](open-questions.md#d-89) What happens to a Worker's upcoming Assignments when their Agency makes them inactive?
- [D-108](open-questions.md#d-108) Which rows does a list show first, where no source gives an order?
- [D-189](open-questions.md#d-189) Can an Agency change or deactivate its Workers?

<a id="req-agency-web-0004"></a>

### List the Agency's Timesheets and submit them

`REQ-AGENCY-WEB-0004`

- **Who:** Agency User
- **What:** On the Timesheets screen an Agency User sees a Timesheet for each of the Agency's Workers on Shifts that have ended. They load hours and Expenses from files and submit Timesheets one at a time, or by Shift, Event, or work date.
- **Why:**
  - Most temp time is on paper today; only about 2% runs through MyStaff *(TS-5: Timesheet intake in any format (PDF, CSV, image), matched to shifts automatically)*
  - The true cost of a Monday event shouldn't stay hidden until week end *(TS-8: Daily or per-event timesheet submission and approval, not just at week end)*
- **Sources:** [Compass sheet](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1SlUyWtbhik3KEKW4VAskSAEfS8v3S-_OjgVfZpA2WM4/edit) 4.3; [Compass sheet](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1SlUyWtbhik3KEKW4VAskSAEfS8v3S-_OjgVfZpA2WM4/edit) TS-5; [Demo sessions](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1Xy3QVWr-aVVV6mpMxWsH6kb987IzwVPXDQ1iW8k83Bo/edit) Timesheets, Tips & Expenses

**Acceptance criteria**

- **R1.** The Timesheets screen lists each Timesheet of the Agency's Workers with Worker, Unit, Position, work date, clock_in, clock_out, break, worked hours, tips, Expenses, and status, grouped by Shift.
- **R2.** It opens on DRAFT and REJECTED Timesheets, oldest work date first, and filters by status, Unit, Event, and work date range.
- **R3.** A REJECTED Timesheet shows the Unit's rejected_reason in its row.
- **R4.** A Timesheet not APPROVED when its Lock Window closed is marked late in the Agency's list until it is approved, as [`REQ-TIME-0007`](business-rules.md#req-time-0007) defines.
- **R5.** A SUBMITTED or APPROVED Timesheet shows its exception_reasons, an APPROVED one shows whether Iris or a Unit User approved it, and a locked one shows a lock mark.
- **R6.** Each DRAFT or REJECTED Timesheet offers Submit, which calls [`REQ-TIME-0002`](business-rules.md#req-time-0002); one with a missing clock time is marked but can still be submitted.
- **R7.** Submit all, offered for one Shift, one Event, or one work date at a Unit, calls [`REQ-TIME-0002`](business-rules.md#req-time-0002) for every DRAFT and REJECTED Timesheet of the Agency there.
- **R8.** After a bulk submit, the screen lists each Timesheet left unsubmitted with the reason.
- **R9.** Upload hours opens the Uploads send step of [`REQ-SHELL-0008`](every-user.md#req-shell-0008) with TIMESHEETS picked, for a template, PDF, or photo of a sign-in sheet; [`REQ-TIME-0003`](business-rules.md#req-time-0003) saves accepted lines without submitting any Timesheet.
- **R10.** Upload expenses opens that step with EXPENSES picked, and [`REQ-TIPS-0002`](business-rules.md#req-tips-0002) adds each accepted row to its Timesheet as a PENDING Expense.

**Business rules it saves through**

- [`REQ-TIME-0001` Hold a Timesheet for each assigned Worker](business-rules.md#req-time-0001)
- [`REQ-TIME-0002` Submit and approve Timesheets daily or per Event](business-rules.md#req-time-0002)
- [`REQ-TIME-0003` Read Timesheets in any format and match them to Shifts](business-rules.md#req-time-0003)
- [`REQ-TIME-0005` Auto-approve within tolerance and surface exceptions](business-rules.md#req-time-0005)
- [`REQ-TIME-0006` Correct or reject a Timesheet with a reason](business-rules.md#req-time-0006)
- [`REQ-TIME-0007` Lock approved Timesheets after the Lock Window](business-rules.md#req-time-0007)
- [`REQ-TIPS-0001` Hold each Timesheet's tips and take the tips an Agency enters](business-rules.md#req-tips-0001)
- [`REQ-TIPS-0002` Add and approve expenses](business-rules.md#req-tips-0002)
- [`REQ-ORDERING-0011` Group Shifts into an Event](business-rules.md#req-ordering-0011)
- [`REQ-ORG-0009` Allow each action only to its role and scope](business-rules.md#req-org-0009)

**Open questions it rests on**

- [D-13](open-questions.md#d-13) What happens to a Timesheet still unapproved when its Lock Window closes: auto-approve, escalate, or block invoicing?
- [D-108](open-questions.md#d-108) Which rows does a list show first, where no source gives an order?
- [D-113](open-questions.md#d-113) Can a Timesheet with a missing clock time or a pending expense be submitted and approved?
- [D-115](open-questions.md#d-115) What does a bulk submit or approve do with the Timesheets it cannot process?

<a id="req-agency-web-0005"></a>

### Manage the Agency's Rate Card and answer Rate Reviews

`REQ-AGENCY-WEB-0005`

- **Who:** Agency User
- **What:** On the Rate Card screen an Agency User sees the Agency's Rate Lines with their Pay Rates, Bill Rates, and Markup. They submit new or changed lines by form or file, and answer Rate Reviews.
- **Why:**
  - About 200K rates sit in spreadsheets with known inaccuracies *(RC-3: Structured rate card by position, market and vendor, replacing the master spreadsheet)*
  - Needed to load pilot-market rates quickly *(RC-4: Bulk rate upload and import)*
  - Know who changed a rate, when and why *(RC-5: Rate change audit trail)*
  - Units need to see deviations and push back on vendors *(RC-12: Rate review: e.g. when an agency's rates run 15%+ above peer rates, ask the agency to lower the rate or justify it)*
- **Sources:** [PRD](https://instawork.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/ec/pages/4841898227/Compass+VMS+Product+Requirements) §3 Supplier Rates; [Compass sheet](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1SlUyWtbhik3KEKW4VAskSAEfS8v3S-_OjgVfZpA2WM4/edit) RC-3; [Compass sheet](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1SlUyWtbhik3KEKW4VAskSAEfS8v3S-_OjgVfZpA2WM4/edit) RC-12

**Acceptance criteria**

- **R1.** The Rate Card screen lists the Agency's Rate Lines, sorted by Market or Unit and then Position, each with its six rates, the Markup of each pair as a percentage, effective_from, effective_to, and status.
- **R2.** It opens on APPROVED lines not yet ended, filters by status, Market or Unit, and Position, and searches by Position name.
- **R3.** The screen never shows the Peer Rate or another Agency's rates (C-15).
- **R4.** Add rate opens the form of [`REQ-RATES-0013`](business-rules.md#req-rates-0013) with no Agency field, and the saved line is listed as PENDING until a Program User approves it or sends it back.
- **R5.** An APPROVED line with no effective_to offers Change, which opens that form filled from the line; saving submits a new line through [`REQ-RATES-0009`](business-rules.md#req-rates-0009) and leaves the old one as it was.
- **R6.** A SENT_BACK line shows the Program User's reason and offers Submit again, which opens the form filled from it to submit a new line.
- **R7.** Upload rates opens the Uploads send step of [`REQ-SHELL-0008`](every-user.md#req-shell-0008) with RATE_CARD picked, and [`REQ-RATES-0002`](business-rules.md#req-rates-0002) submits each accepted row as a PENDING line.
- **R8.** A History tab lists every line the Agency ever submitted, as [`REQ-RATES-0003`](business-rules.md#req-rates-0003) keeps them, and each line opens its change history through [`REQ-SHELL-0011`](every-user.md#req-shell-0011), shown to that Agency's Agency Users.
- **R9.** REQUESTED Rate Reviews show above the list, each with the line under review and a statement that its rate is above its peers.
- **R10.** Each REQUESTED review offers Keep the rate, which takes a reason, and Lower the rate, which opens the form of [`REQ-RATES-0013`](business-rules.md#req-rates-0013) for the new line, as [`REQ-RATES-0008.R8`](business-rules.md#req-rates-0008) allows.
- **R11.** A review answered with a reason shows as KEPT; one answered with a lower line stays REQUESTED until that line is APPROVED, then shows as LOWERED.
- **R12.** This requirement registers the Rate Card screen with [`REQ-SHELL-0007`](every-user.md#req-shell-0007) for role AGENCY_USER: subject RateLine opens the History tab at that line, and subject RateReview the screen at that review.

**Business rules it saves through**

- [`REQ-RATES-0001` Hold each Agency's Rate Card](business-rules.md#req-rates-0001)
- [`REQ-RATES-0002` Load Rate Lines in bulk](business-rules.md#req-rates-0002)
- [`REQ-RATES-0003` Keep a history of every rate change](business-rules.md#req-rates-0003)
- [`REQ-RATES-0008` Ask an Agency to review a rate above its peers](business-rules.md#req-rates-0008)
- [`REQ-RATES-0009` Submit Rate Lines and approve them before they price work](business-rules.md#req-rates-0009)
- [`REQ-RATES-0013` Add or change one Rate Line by form](business-rules.md#req-rates-0013)
- [`REQ-ORG-0009` Allow each action only to its role and scope](business-rules.md#req-org-0009)

- [D-11](open-questions.md#d-11) Which side of the rate is contracted: the Bill Rate, or the Pay Rate plus a fixed markup? The session notes leave a bill and pay rate flip pending.
- [D-84](open-questions.md#d-84) Who sees the Peer Rate?

<a id="req-agency-web-0006"></a>

### Assign, swap, and remove Workers on an accepted Release

`REQ-AGENCY-WEB-0006` · first slice

- **Who:** Agency User
- **What:** On an accepted Release, an Agency User picks Workers from the Agency's roster to fill its headcount, and swaps or removes them until the Shift ends. A Worker who cannot be assigned shows why.
- **Why:** Compass needs to know who is actually coming on site *(WA-1: Agency roster: agencies assign named workers to allocated shifts)*
- **Sources:** [Compass sheet](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1SlUyWtbhik3KEKW4VAskSAEfS8v3S-_OjgVfZpA2WM4/edit) WA-1; [Demo sessions](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1Xy3QVWr-aVVV6mpMxWsH6kb987IzwVPXDQ1iW8k83Bo/edit) Worker Assignment & Compliance

**Acceptance criteria**

- **R1.** The Release page of [`REQ-AGENCY-WEB-0002`](#req-agency-web-0002) shows, for an ACCEPTED Release whose Shift has not ended, its ASSIGNED Workers and open headcount, and offers Assign while any headcount is open.
- **R2.** The assign list holds the Agency's active Workers, searchable by name.
- **R3.** Workers who can be assigned are listed first, and each other Worker cannot be picked and shows the reasons [`REQ-WORKFORCE-0003.R26`](business-rules.md#req-workforce-0003) returns.
- **R4.** The reasons shown are that the Worker is already on the Shift, is rated BLOCK by the Unit, lacks named Credential Types, or would add overtime while OVERTIME_HARD_BLOCK is true.
- **R5.** The Agency User can pick at most as many Workers as the Release has open headcount, and the screen shows how many are picked.
- **R6.** Confirming calls [`REQ-WORKFORCE-0003`](business-rules.md#req-workforce-0003) once for each picked Worker, and a Worker it then refuses stays unassigned with the reason shown.
- **R7.** When [`REQ-LABOR-0003`](business-rules.md#req-labor-0003) allows an assignment that adds overtime, the screen shows the answer of [`REQ-WORKFORCE-0003.R21`](business-rules.md#req-workforce-0003): each Unit and Work Week in which the Worker now has more overtime, counting their Shifts at every Unit.
- **R8.** Until the Shift ends, each ASSIGNED Worker offers Remove, which calls [`REQ-WORKFORCE-0003`](business-rules.md#req-workforce-0003) and reopens that headcount on the Release.
- **R9.** Each ASSIGNED Worker also offers Swap, which opens the assign list to pick one replacement and calls [`REQ-WORKFORCE-0003`](business-rules.md#req-workforce-0003) to swap the two in one step.
- **R10.** Workers who came off the Release are listed below the assigned ones with the removal reason, such as NOT_ELIGIBLE or BLOCKED_BY_UNIT.
- **R11.** Each ASSIGNED Worker shows when site instructions were last sent to them under [`REQ-ORDERING-0006`](business-rules.md#req-ordering-0006), or that none were sent, with the reason when the Worker has neither an email nor a phone.
- **R12.** After the Shift ends, the Release lists its Workers with no Assign, Swap, or Remove.
- **R13.** When an assigned Worker has neither an email nor a phone, the screen shows the answer of [`REQ-WORKFORCE-0003.R24`](business-rules.md#req-workforce-0003), so the Agency passes the site instructions on.

**Business rules it saves through**

- [`REQ-WORKFORCE-0001` Hold each Agency's Worker roster](business-rules.md#req-workforce-0001)
- [`REQ-WORKFORCE-0003` Assign named Workers to an accepted Release](business-rules.md#req-workforce-0003)
- [`REQ-WORKFORCE-0005` Rate a Worker as Favorite, Okay to return, or Block](business-rules.md#req-workforce-0005)
- [`REQ-COMPLIANCE-0005` Decide whether a Worker is eligible for a Shift](business-rules.md#req-compliance-0005)
- [`REQ-LABOR-0003` Track overtime within each Agency and alert](business-rules.md#req-labor-0003)
- [`REQ-DISPATCH-0002` Accept or decline a Release](business-rules.md#req-dispatch-0002)
- [`REQ-ORDERING-0006` Share structured site instructions with the Agency and Workers](business-rules.md#req-ordering-0006)
- [`REQ-ORG-0009` Allow each action only to its role and scope](business-rules.md#req-org-0009)
- [`REQ-WORKFORCE-0016` Take Workers off Shifts automatically and recheck their eligibility](business-rules.md#req-workforce-0016)

**Open questions it rests on**

- [D-4](open-questions.md#d-4) Who owes overtime when a Worker spans Units or Agencies? Needs HR, legal, and payroll.
- [D-51](open-questions.md#d-51) What happens to a Worker's upcoming Assignments when the Unit blocks them or they stop being eligible?
- [D-88](open-questions.md#d-88) What happens when an assigned Worker has no email and no phone, so site instructions cannot be sent to them?
- [D-133](open-questions.md#d-133) Whose Work Week governs when the Units an Agency sends a Worker to start their weeks on different days? Example, with overtime after 40 hours a week: Unit A's week starts Monday and Unit B's Thursday. Ten hours a day Monday to Wednesday at A and Thursday to Saturday at B bill no overtime; the same days with the Units swapped bill 20 hours of it. Needs HR, legal, and payroll.
- [D-157](open-questions.md#d-157) How is a Shift's headcount shared among its Releases?
- [D-164](open-questions.md#d-164) Can a Worker be added to a Shift after it ends?

<a id="req-agency-web-0007"></a>

### Manage one Worker's Credentials and Attestations

`REQ-AGENCY-WEB-0007`

- **Who:** Agency User
- **What:** A Worker's page shows their details, every Credential and Attestation with its state, and what Units say about them. An Agency User uploads Credentials and records Attestations there.
- **Why:**
  - Lapsed certifications shouldn't slip through *(WA-14: Certification upload with expiry tracking)*
  - Agencies attest; Compass audits *(WA-16: Attestation records and audit trail for agency-worker compliance (audited by Compass or the MSP))*
- **Sources:** [Compass sheet](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1SlUyWtbhik3KEKW4VAskSAEfS8v3S-_OjgVfZpA2WM4/edit) WA-14; [Compass sheet](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1SlUyWtbhik3KEKW4VAskSAEfS8v3S-_OjgVfZpA2WM4/edit) WA-16; [PRD](https://instawork.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/ec/pages/4841898227/Compass+VMS+Product+Requirements) §4 Professionals

**Acceptance criteria**

- **R1.** The page shows the Worker's name, contact details, photo, Positions, and the number of WORKED Shifts they were assigned to.
- **R2.** Credentials are listed by Credential Type, newest first, each with issuer, number, issued_on, expires_on, status, the status_reason or review_note, and a link that opens the document under [`REQ-COMPLIANCE-0002.R14`](business-rules.md#req-compliance-0002).
- **R3.** A VERIFIED Credential past its expires_on is labelled expired, one within CREDENTIAL_EXPIRY_WARNING_DAYS of it is labelled expiring, and one with a newer Credential of its type is labelled replaced.
- **R4.** Upload Credential takes an active Credential Type, the document file, an optional issuer, number, and issued_on, and expires_on when the type expires, and saves through [`REQ-COMPLIANCE-0002`](business-rules.md#req-compliance-0002).
- **R5.** A document sent without details goes as a CREDENTIALS Upload, and the page shows its Proposal in the card of [`REQ-ASSISTANT-0002`](every-user.md#req-assistant-0002) for the Agency User to confirm or correct.
- **R6.** A saved Credential offers no edit or delete; a correction or a renewal is uploaded as a new Credential.
- **R7.** Attestations are listed by Credential Type, newest first, with statement, valid_until, who attested, and when, and only the latest of each type is marked current or lapsed.
- **R8.** Attest takes an active Credential Type, a statement, and an optional valid_until, and records a new Attestation through [`REQ-COMPLIANCE-0004`](business-rules.md#req-compliance-0004), leaving earlier ones listed.
- **R9.** For a Credential Type whose proof is VERIFIED_DOCUMENT, the page says an Attestation alone does not make the Worker eligible.
- **R10.** The page lists each Unit's rating of the Worker, FAVORITE, OKAY_TO_RETURN, or BLOCK, with its review, and offers the Agency User no way to change it.
- **R11.** It lists the issues Units reported on the Worker, each with its category and status.
- **R12.** On each row of the roster of [`REQ-AGENCY-WEB-0003`](#req-agency-web-0003), this requirement shows how many of the Worker's Credentials are REJECTED, expired, or within CREDENTIAL_EXPIRY_WARNING_DAYS of expiry and not replaced by a newer one.
- **R13.** Each roster row also shows how many of the Worker's Credentials are PENDING_CHECK or NEEDS_REVIEW, and the roster filters to Workers counted in either group.
- **R14.** Selecting a Worker on the roster opens this page.
- **R15.** Upload Credentials on the roster opens the Uploads send step of [`REQ-SHELL-0008`](every-user.md#req-shell-0008) with CREDENTIALS picked, takes one PDF or image for each Credential, and [`REQ-COMPLIANCE-0002`](business-rules.md#req-compliance-0002) saves them.
- **R16.** This requirement registers the Worker's page with [`REQ-SHELL-0007`](every-user.md#req-shell-0007) for subjects Worker and Credential and role AGENCY_USER, and a notification about a Credential opens the page of its Worker.

<a id="req-agency-web-0008"></a>

### See and resolve Worker issues reported by Units

`REQ-AGENCY-WEB-0008`

- **Who:** Agency User
- **What:** On the Issues tab of the Workers screen, an Agency User sees each issue a Unit reported on one of the Agency's Workers. They resolve it with a note the Unit can read.
- **Why:** VMS requirement: report associate issues *(WA-4: Report an associate issue (conduct, safety, quality, no-show) routed to the agency, with resolution tracking)*
- **Sources:** [Compass sheet](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1SlUyWtbhik3KEKW4VAskSAEfS8v3S-_OjgVfZpA2WM4/edit) WA-4

**Acceptance criteria**

- **R1.** The Issues tab of the Workers screen of [`REQ-AGENCY-WEB-0003`](#req-agency-web-0003) lists each issue on the Agency's Workers with the Worker, Unit, category, description, the Shift when one was named, the report date, and status.
- **R2.** OPEN issues come first, oldest first, then RESOLVED ones, newest first, and the list filters by status, category, Worker, and Unit.
- **R3.** An OPEN issue offers Resolve, which takes a resolution note and calls [`REQ-WORKFORCE-0006`](business-rules.md#req-workforce-0006).
- **R4.** A RESOLVED issue shows its resolution, who resolved it, and when, and offers no further action.
- **R5.** This requirement registers the Issues tab with [`REQ-SHELL-0007`](every-user.md#req-shell-0007) for subject WorkerIssue and role AGENCY_USER, opened at that issue.

**Business rules it saves through**

- [`REQ-WORKFORCE-0001` Hold each Agency's Worker roster](business-rules.md#req-workforce-0001)
- [`REQ-WORKFORCE-0006` Report a Worker issue to the Agency](business-rules.md#req-workforce-0006)
- [`REQ-ORG-0009` Allow each action only to its role and scope](business-rules.md#req-org-0009)

- [D-107](open-questions.md#d-107) How can the first slice be used before every screen and feature exists?
- [D-108](open-questions.md#d-108) Which rows does a list show first, where no source gives an order?
- [D-123](open-questions.md#d-123) Which screens does an Agency User have?
- [D-252](open-questions.md#d-252) Which record is each notification about?

<a id="req-agency-web-0009"></a>

### Enter hours, tips, and Expenses on a Timesheet

`REQ-AGENCY-WEB-0009`

- **Who:** Agency User
- **What:** On a Draft or Rejected Timesheet, an Agency User enters the hours billed, marks a no-show, splits it by role, and adds the Worker's tip and Expenses. In any other status the page is read-only and shows every change.
- **Why:**
  - Mid-shift role and rate changes are rarely captured *(TS-10: Split a shift by time and position for mid-shift role changes (e.g. bartender → barback))*
  - Tip pooling is manual; stadiums use cashier PINs *(TS-11: Tips entry (bulk or chat), split by hours worked)*
  - Expenses flow through the same process *(TS-12: Expense entry and approval)*
- **Sources:** [PRD](https://instawork.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/ec/pages/4841898227/Compass+VMS+Product+Requirements) §2 Shifts; [Compass sheet](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1SlUyWtbhik3KEKW4VAskSAEfS8v3S-_OjgVfZpA2WM4/edit) 4.4; [Demo sessions](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1Xy3QVWr-aVVV6mpMxWsH6kb987IzwVPXDQ1iW8k83Bo/edit) Timesheets, Tips & Expenses

**Acceptance criteria**

- **R1.** The page shows the Shift's Unit, Position, and scheduled times beside the Timesheet's clock_in, clock_out, break_minutes, minutes in each hour class, three Bill Rates, and the amount for each class.
- **R2.** While the Timesheet is DRAFT or REJECTED and is_no_show is false, the Agency User can change clock_in, clock_out, and break_minutes through [`REQ-TIME-0001`](business-rules.md#req-time-0001); otherwise those fields are read-only.
- **R3.** The three Bill Rates are read-only in every status, as [`REQ-TIME-0001.R10`](business-rules.md#req-time-0001) requires.
- **R4.** While the Timesheet is DRAFT or REJECTED, Mark no-show calls [`REQ-TIME-0009`](business-rules.md#req-time-0009); Clear no-show is offered only on a mark an Agency User set, and a mark a Unit User set says so.
- **R5.** Split by role asks for a switch time and a new Position, a new Department of the Unit, or both, calls [`REQ-TIME-0008`](business-rules.md#req-time-0008), and then shows each part with its own rates.
- **R6.** The split form lets the Agency User move some of the break minutes to the new part, and shows that the two parts keep the original total.
- **R7.** The Agency User can enter, change, or remove a tip for the Worker through [`REQ-TIPS-0001`](business-rules.md#req-tips-0001), and the page says such a tip keeps the Timesheet from being approved automatically.
- **R8.** Tips from a Tip Pool or a cashier PIN are listed with their source and cannot be changed here.
- **R9.** Add Expense takes a kind of PARKING, BACKGROUND_CHECK, or OTHER, an amount, and a note, which OTHER requires, and saves a PENDING Expense through [`REQ-TIPS-0002`](business-rules.md#req-tips-0002).
- **R10.** A PENDING Expense can be changed or deleted while the Timesheet is DRAFT or REJECTED; a decided Expense shows APPROVED, or REJECTED with the Unit's reason, and cannot be changed.
- **R11.** A REJECTED Timesheet shows the Unit's rejected_reason above the hours until it is submitted again.
- **R12.** The page embeds the Timesheet's change history through [`REQ-SHELL-0011`](every-user.md#req-shell-0011), shown to Agency Users of the Worker's Agency, so each correction a Unit User made can be read with its reason.
- **R13.** The page opens from a row of the Timesheets screen of [`REQ-AGENCY-WEB-0004`](#req-agency-web-0004) and from each Worker of an ended Release on [`REQ-AGENCY-WEB-0006`](#req-agency-web-0006).
- **R14.** This requirement registers the Timesheet's page with [`REQ-SHELL-0007`](every-user.md#req-shell-0007) for subject Timesheet and role AGENCY_USER.

**Business rules it saves through**

- [`REQ-TIME-0001` Hold a Timesheet for each assigned Worker](business-rules.md#req-time-0001)
- [`REQ-TIME-0002` Submit and approve Timesheets daily or per Event](business-rules.md#req-time-0002)
- [`REQ-TIME-0006` Correct or reject a Timesheet with a reason](business-rules.md#req-time-0006)
- [`REQ-TIME-0008` Split a Timesheet when a Worker changes role](business-rules.md#req-time-0008)
- [`REQ-TIME-0009` Mark a Worker as a no-show](business-rules.md#req-time-0009)
- [`REQ-TIPS-0001` Hold each Timesheet's tips and take the tips an Agency enters](business-rules.md#req-tips-0001)
- [`REQ-TIPS-0002` Add and approve expenses](business-rules.md#req-tips-0002)
- [`REQ-DISPATCH-0001` Send a Shift's headcount to a chosen Agency](business-rules.md#req-dispatch-0001)
- [`REQ-ORG-0002` Add a Unit and its Departments](business-rules.md#req-org-0002)
- [`REQ-CATALOG-0001` Hold the Compass Position catalog](business-rules.md#req-catalog-0001)
- [`REQ-ORG-0009` Allow each action only to its role and scope](business-rules.md#req-org-0009)

<a id="req-agency-web-0010"></a>

### Manage the Agency's own Users

`REQ-AGENCY-WEB-0010`

- **Who:** Agency User
- **What:** On the Users screen an Agency User sees who has access to their Agency, invites colleagues, and revokes access or deactivates a User, within the limits [`REQ-ORG-0005`](business-rules.md#req-org-0005) sets.
- **Why:**
  - Each persona gets its own view *(PLT-1: RBAC: unit (buyer), agency (supplier), corporate/program owner)*
  - MSP task: profile and password management *(PLT-4: User accounts with login, profiles and password management)*
- **Sources:** [Compass sheet](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1SlUyWtbhik3KEKW4VAskSAEfS8v3S-_OjgVfZpA2WM4/edit) PLT-1; [Compass sheet](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1SlUyWtbhik3KEKW4VAskSAEfS8v3S-_OjgVfZpA2WM4/edit) PLT-4

**Acceptance criteria**

- **R1.** The Users screen lists every User holding an AGENCY_USER Role Grant for the Agency, with name, email, phone, whether the invite was accepted, last sign-in, and whether the grant is revoked or the User inactive.
- **R2.** Invite takes an email, first name, last name, and optional phone and calls [`REQ-ORG-0005`](business-rules.md#req-org-0005) to grant AGENCY_USER for this Agency; the form offers no other role and no other Agency.
- **R3.** A User who has not accepted their invite offers Send invite again, which sends a new link through [`REQ-IDENTITY-0002`](behind-the-scenes.md#req-identity-0002).
- **R4.** Each unrevoked grant offers Revoke and each revoked grant offers Restore, both through [`REQ-ORG-0005`](business-rules.md#req-org-0005).
- **R5.** Deactivate and Reactivate call [`REQ-ORG-0005`](business-rules.md#req-org-0005), which refuses them for a User who holds any Role Grant other than AGENCY_USER for this Agency.

**Business rules it saves through**

- [`REQ-ORG-0005` Grant a role within a scope](business-rules.md#req-org-0005)
- [`REQ-ORG-0009` Allow each action only to its role and scope](business-rules.md#req-org-0009)

**Open questions it rests on**

- [D-25](open-questions.md#d-25) Who manages Users?
- [D-152](open-questions.md#d-152) What happens when an invite names an email a User already holds?

<a id="req-agency-web-0011"></a>

### Agency Home: to-dos

`REQ-AGENCY-WEB-0011`

- **Who:** Agency User
- **What:** An Agency User's Home lists what the Agency must do next: Releases to answer and staff, Timesheets to submit or fix, Credentials to renew, Rate Reviews, and Worker issues.
- **Why:** Each persona gets its own view *(PLT-1: RBAC: unit (buyer), agency (supplier), corporate/program owner)*
- **Sources:** [PRD](https://instawork.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/ec/pages/4841898227/Compass+VMS+Product+Requirements) §1 How Todos behave; [PRD](https://instawork.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/ec/pages/4841898227/Compass+VMS+Product+Requirements) §1 Who sees what; [Compass sheet](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1SlUyWtbhik3KEKW4VAskSAEfS8v3S-_OjgVfZpA2WM4/edit) PLT-1

**Acceptance criteria**

- **R1.** Home ([`REQ-AGENCY-WEB-0001`](#req-agency-web-0001)) shows the to-do list of [`REQ-SHELL-0003`](every-user.md#req-shell-0003) with seven lines: Releases to answer, Releases to staff, Timesheets to submit, Timesheets sent back, Credentials to renew, Rate Reviews to answer, and Worker issues to resolve.
- **R2.** Releases to answer counts the Agency's PENDING Releases, shows the time until the earliest of their Shifts starts, and opens the Shifts screen of [`REQ-AGENCY-WEB-0002`](#req-agency-web-0002) filtered to them.
- **R3.** Releases to staff counts ACCEPTED Releases with open headcount on Shifts that have not ended, shows the time until the earliest starts, and opens them on the Shifts screen of [`REQ-AGENCY-WEB-0002`](#req-agency-web-0002).
- **R4.** Timesheets to submit counts the Agency's DRAFT Timesheets, shows the age of the oldest since its Shift ended and how many are late under [`REQ-TIME-0007`](business-rules.md#req-time-0007), and opens them on [`REQ-AGENCY-WEB-0004`](#req-agency-web-0004).
- **R5.** Timesheets sent back counts the Agency's REJECTED Timesheets, shows the same two figures, and opens them on [`REQ-AGENCY-WEB-0004`](#req-agency-web-0004).
- **R6.** Credentials to renew counts the Credentials of the Agency's active Workers that need action under [`REQ-COMPLIANCE-0002`](business-rules.md#req-compliance-0002), shows the earliest expiry date among them, and opens the roster filtered to those Workers, as [`REQ-AGENCY-WEB-0007.R13`](#req-agency-web-0007) adds.
- **R7.** Rate Reviews to answer counts the Agency's REQUESTED Rate Reviews, shows the age of the oldest, and opens them on the Rate Card screen of [`REQ-AGENCY-WEB-0005`](#req-agency-web-0005).
- **R8.** Worker issues to resolve counts OPEN Worker issues on the Agency's Workers, shows the age of the oldest, and opens the Issues tab of [`REQ-AGENCY-WEB-0008`](#req-agency-web-0008).
- **R9.** The Agency Home has no second section in MVP (C-21), so it shows the to-do list even when no line has a count.

- [`REQ-WORKFORCE-0003` Assign named Workers to an accepted Release](business-rules.md#req-workforce-0003)

- [`REQ-TIME-0006` Correct or reject a Timesheet with a reason](business-rules.md#req-time-0006)
- [`REQ-TIME-0007` Lock approved Timesheets after the Lock Window](business-rules.md#req-time-0007)

- [`REQ-COMPLIANCE-0003` Validate Credential documents with AI and review what it cannot settle](business-rules.md#req-compliance-0003)
- [`REQ-RATES-0008` Ask an Agency to review a rate above its peers](business-rules.md#req-rates-0008)
- [`REQ-WORKFORCE-0006` Report a Worker issue to the Agency](business-rules.md#req-workforce-0006)
- [`REQ-ORG-0006` Resolve a Setting for a Unit](business-rules.md#req-org-0006)

<a id="req-agency-web-0012"></a>

### Upload Worker assignments from the Shifts screen

`REQ-AGENCY-WEB-0012`

- **Who:** Agency User
- **What:** From the Shifts screen an Agency User uploads a SHIFTS file that names the Workers to assign to the Shifts released to their Agency.

<a id="req-agency-web-0013"></a>

### Upload Workers from the roster

`REQ-AGENCY-WEB-0013`

- **Who:** Agency User
- **What:** From the Workers screen an Agency User uploads a WORKERS file to add or change many Workers at once.
- **Why:** Compass needs to know who is actually coming on site *(WA-1: Agency roster: agencies assign named workers to allocated shifts)*
- **Sources:** [Compass sheet](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1SlUyWtbhik3KEKW4VAskSAEfS8v3S-_OjgVfZpA2WM4/edit) WA-1; [PRD](https://instawork.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/ec/pages/4841898227/Compass+VMS+Product+Requirements) §4 Professionals

**Acceptance criteria**

- **R1.** This requirement adds Upload Workers to the Workers screen of [`REQ-AGENCY-WEB-0003`](#req-agency-web-0003), which opens the Uploads send step of [`REQ-SHELL-0008`](every-user.md#req-shell-0008) with WORKERS picked, and [`REQ-WORKFORCE-0017`](business-rules.md#req-workforce-0017) saves the accepted rows.

**Business rules it saves through**

- [`REQ-WORKFORCE-0017` Load Workers from a file](business-rules.md#req-workforce-0017)

<a id="req-agency-web-0014"></a>

### See the Workers a Unit requested by name and say when one cannot work

`REQ-AGENCY-WEB-0014`

- **Who:** Agency User
- **What:** On a Release, an Agency User sees the Workers the Unit requested by name and marks any who cannot work as unavailable. Requested Workers come first when assigning.
- **Why:** Favorite rosters must carry over (one operator always requests the same 20 people) *(WA-2: Request specific workers, linked to the worker record)*
- **Sources:** [Compass sheet](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1SlUyWtbhik3KEKW4VAskSAEfS8v3S-_OjgVfZpA2WM4/edit) WA-2

**Acceptance criteria**

- **R1.** This requirement adds to each PENDING or ACCEPTED Release on the Shifts screen of [`REQ-AGENCY-WEB-0002`](#req-agency-web-0002) a list of the Workers the Unit requested by name.
- **R2.** Each REQUESTED Worker in that list offers Mark unavailable, which takes a reason and calls [`REQ-WORKFORCE-0004`](business-rules.md#req-workforce-0004).
- **R3.** In the assign list of [`REQ-AGENCY-WEB-0006`](#req-agency-web-0006), the Workers the Unit requested by name are marked and listed first.

**Business rules it saves through**

- [`REQ-WORKFORCE-0004` Request specific Workers by name](business-rules.md#req-workforce-0004)

**Open questions it rests on**
